status: frozen before any run; deterministic arm runnable; model arms NOT_RUN (no budget approved by the owner for paid model calls)
author: VozNativa developer's agent (not independent): the cases were written after the v0.6.0 temporal, community, long-text and literary rules they exercise
cases: 22: 6 temporal slang (author's slang kept, slang not added for a 'current' request, epoch notes, author's slang removed, stuffing, other senses not read as slang), 4 community (terms kept and anglicism findings withdrawn, control without the community, jargon added by a candidate, unknown pack), 2 long texts (dependencies a cut must not break, dialogue), 4 literary (2 verse, literary prose with period spelling and characters' forms of address, the same text without the genre as a recorded risk), 3 natural texts, 2 AI-style drafts, 1 regional regression
class: conformance of VozNativa's deterministic decisions to the v0.6.0 specification; not a quality benchmark

D-voznativa-v060-deterministic.what: route + Voice Contract + plan + editorial report + engine review of a given candidate + segmentation; no model call

not_run_arms.B0-original: needs a judge only for preference; not part of the deterministic arm
not_run_arms.B6-voznativa-v060-engine: model call (rewrite with plan, review and judge); no budget approved

metrics.per_case: every key of `expect` is one check; a case passes when all its checks pass
metrics.summary: cases passed with a 95% Wilson interval; n = 22 is a conformance count, not an estimate of quality
metrics.must_preserve: kept for model arms; the deterministic arm does not rewrite

freeze_rule: the cases file is not edited after this commit; a wrong expectation is reported and determined (case error or implementation bug), and a later suite version fixes it
bias_disclosure: Cases, expectations, rules and runner are VozNativa's own and were written by the same agent; passing shows the implementation does what its specification says, not that the specification is right for readers
